title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Record State Required to Decide a Claim
content:
A claim under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` is decided in one of two ways: it is approved for settlement or it is rejected. Each way of deciding presupposes a particular state of the cover and of the claim file, as the line's records show it.

## Clauses

1. **Approval.** Approval of a settlement requires, at the moment of approval, a cover showing the status claim open and a claim file standing at documents complete.
2. **Rejection.** Booking a rejection requires, at that moment, a cover showing the status claim open.
3. **A single decision.** Every claim is decided once. A claim that already carries an approval or a rejection receives no further decision of either kind.

## Truth table for the record state

| Cover status is claim open | Claim file stands at documents complete | Claim already decided | Record state admits approval | Record state admits rejection |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no | yes | yes |
| yes | no | no | no | yes |
| no | yes or no | no | no | no |
| any | any | yes | no | no |

A "yes" in the last two columns means only that the record state stands in the way of neither decision. The grounds that make a claim payable or rejectable are a separate question.

## Basis Q&A

- *A claim file stands at documents complete, but the cover shows a closed claim. Can the settlement be approved?* No. Approval needs the cover in the claim open status.
- *The claimant withdrew its claim and the cover returned to active status. Does the record state admit a rejection of that claim?* No. The cover no longer shows the status claim open.
- *A claim was rejected last week. Can it now be approved?* No. It has been decided already.
